meta.section: Reading 大問1（語句空所補充）
meta.source: ユーザー提供画像（原本表記は模試第3回）を、依頼により模試第8回として構造化。既存語句との重複を避けるため一部選択肢を置換

questions.stem: At first, Patricia enjoyed being the manager of the local football club, but over time the numerous administrative duties became an (   ) task that she no longer enjoyed.
questions.translation: 最初、パトリシアは地元のサッカークラブの責任者であることを楽しんでいたが、やがて数多くの事務的な職務が、楽しめない負担の大きい仕事になった。

questions.stem: After the public heard Mayor Wilson expressing his racist and sexist views in a recording, he was (   ) by almost everyone.
questions.translation: ウィルソン市長が録音の中で人種差別的・性差別的な見解を述べているのを世間が聞いた後、彼はほとんど全員から激しく非難された。

questions.stem: Before they got their new heating system, the upstairs of their house was always hotter than the basement. Now, though, the heat is (   ) much more evenly than it was before.
questions.translation: 新しい暖房システムを取り付ける前は、家の2階がいつも地下室より暑かった。しかし今では、熱が以前よりずっと均等に拡散している。

questions.stem: No one noticed as the magician (   ) placed the ball into his jacket pocket while pretending to take something else out of it.
questions.translation: その手品師が別の物を取り出すふりをしながら、こっそりボールを上着のポケットに入れたことに誰も気づかなかった。

questions.stem: This skincare product is recommended for those with lighter (   ) who tend to burn more easily in the sun than those with darker skin.
questions.translation: このスキンケア製品は、肌の色が濃い人よりも日光で焼けやすい、肌の色が明るい人に推奨される。

questions.stem: In the past, it was usual for people in some countries to take (   ) lessons in order to get rid of their regional accents. However, these days, such lessons are less common.
questions.translation: かつて一部の国では、地域なまりをなくすために発音のレッスンを受けるのが普通だった。しかし最近では、そのようなレッスンはあまり一般的ではない。

questions.stem: This painting by the famous artist depicts a typical (   ) scene of green fields and shepherds tending their sheep, with a little church in the background.
questions.translation: その有名な画家の絵は、緑の野原と羊の世話をする羊飼い、背景の小さな教会がある典型的な牧歌的風景を描いている。

questions.stem:
A: Oh, no. The heavy rain seems to have turned the rugby pitch into a (   ).
B: I hope it dries out before the match on Saturday. It looks really slippery.
questions.translation:
A：ああ、大変。激しい雨でラグビー場が泥沼になったようだ。
B：土曜日の試合までに乾くといいね。本当に滑りやすそうだ。

questions.stem: Isaiah's friends tried to (   ) him into going to the party with them, but nothing they said could change his mind. He knew he needed to study for the test.
questions.translation: イザヤの友人たちは彼を説得して一緒にパーティーへ行こうとしたが、何を言っても彼の考えを変えられなかった。彼はテストの勉強が必要だと分かっていた。

questions.stem: After the accident, the Prime Minister offered his (   ) to those who had lost their lives as well as their families. He also said he was praying for the speedy recovery of the injured.
questions.translation: 事故の後、首相は命を失った人々とその家族に哀悼の意を表した。また、負傷者が早く回復するよう祈っていると述べた。

questions.stem:
A: I heard you're selling your art on the Internet, Alison.
B: Yes, it's a great way to (   ) my income. I made an extra $700 last month.
questions.translation:
A：アリソン、インターネットで作品を売っているんだってね。
B：うん、収入を増やすいい方法だよ。先月は700ドル余分に稼いだんだ。

questions.stem: In his public statement, the defendant expressed (   ) for his crimes, stating that he was deeply sorry and that he would do his best to make up for his mistakes.
questions.translation: 被告は公式声明で、自分の犯罪について深い悔恨を示し、心から申し訳なく思っており、過ちを償うために最善を尽くすと述べた。

questions.stem: After more than 20 years as manager, Fernando was reluctant to (   ) control of the department. However, he knew that it was time for someone new to take over.
questions.translation: 20年以上管理職を務めたフェルナンドは、部署の統率を手放すことに気が進まなかった。しかし、新しい人が引き継ぐ時期だと分かっていた。

questions.stem: The travel company offers exciting trips to the Amazon rainforest that are ideal for (   ) travelers who enjoy adventure and do not mind sleeping in a tent.
questions.translation: その旅行会社は、冒険を楽しみ、テントで寝ることを苦にしない冒険好きな旅行者に最適な、アマゾン熱帯雨林への刺激的な旅行を提供している。

questions.stem: Despite the fact that it was his first major acting part, Michael performed the role of Hamlet with (   ) skill. In fact, he was so good that the audience gave him a standing ovation.
questions.translation: それが初めての主要な演技の役だったにもかかわらず、マイケルは完璧な技量でハムレットを演じた。実際、あまりに見事だったので観客はスタンディングオベーションを送った。

questions.stem: Dara was looking forward to a nice hot bath after her long journey. However, the thermostat in her house was not working properly and only (   ) water came out of the tap.
questions.translation: ダーラは長旅の後に熱い風呂に入るのを楽しみにしていた。しかし家の温度調節器が正常に働かず、蛇口からはぬるい水しか出なかった。

questions.stem: After reading an article (   ) the art and architecture of Italy, Jasmine decided it would be her next travel destination. If it was half as good as the article said, she would definitely enjoy it.
questions.translation: イタリアの美術と建築を賞賛する記事を読んだ後、ジャスミンは次の旅行先をイタリアにしようと決めた。記事に書かれていたことの半分でも本当なら、きっと楽しめるだろう。

questions.stem: In his first speech, the presidential candidate assured the audience that he was committed to ending both racial and religious (   ) within the government.
questions.translation: 大統領候補は初演説で、政府内の人種差別と宗教差別の両方を終わらせる決意だと聴衆に保証した。

questions.stem: The newspaper columnist is in the habit of making cruel and (   ) remarks about celebrities. However, his recent comments went too far and led to a record number of complaints.
questions.translation: その新聞コラムニストは、有名人について残酷で軽蔑的な発言をする癖がある。しかし、最近の発言は行き過ぎ、過去最多の苦情につながった。

questions.stem: Upper management had been trying to keep the pay cuts a secret, but news about them gradually began to (   ) down among the staff. Now, almost everyone knows about the changes.
questions.translation: 経営陣は賃金カットを秘密にしようとしていたが、その知らせは徐々に職員の間へ染み出るように広まった。今ではほとんど全員が変更を知っている。

questions.stem: The tax officer ordered a full investigation of the company's finances after noticing several (   ) in their annual tax report.
questions.translation: 税務署員は、年次納税報告書にいくつかの不一致があることに気づいた後、会社の財務について全面的な調査を命じた。

questions.stem: When Professor Briggs was sick, the university could not find anyone to (   ) him, so all of his lectures were canceled.
questions.translation: ブリッグス教授が病気になったとき、大学は彼の代理を務める人を見つけられなかったので、彼の講義はすべて中止された。

questions.stem: When the runner twisted his ankle during the marathon, he was forced to (   ) 10 kilometers before the finish.
questions.translation: そのランナーはマラソン中に足首をひねり、ゴールまで10キロのところで棄権せざるを得なかった。

questions.stem:
A: Pamela, do you have any ideas for how I can (   ) more business for my café?
B: Why don't you make some flyers and hand them out on the street? That worked well when I first opened my restaurant.
questions.translation:
A：パメラ、どうしたらカフェにもっと客を呼び込めるか、何かアイデアはある？
B：チラシを作って通りで配ったら？私が初めてレストランを開いたときにはうまくいったよ。

questions.stem: Last year, the housing market improved, so many people (   ) low interest rates, which were available through their home loans.
questions.translation: 昨年は住宅市場が改善したため、多くの人が住宅ローンで利用できた低金利を活用した。
